title: Fisher-KPP: an advantageous gene or population advances as a wave of fixed speed
look_for_in_this_kingdom: post-glacial tree migration from pollen (Neotoma), invasive plant spread rates, allele or herbicide-resistance spread
variables_needed: front position through time or space

claims.label: Fisher-KPP wave of advance of an advantageous gene
claims.statement: An advantageous allele spreading through a continuous population advances as a travelling wave whose speed is set by the selection coefficient and the diffusion (dispersal) rate.

other_kingdoms_hint.animals: invasion fronts (cane toad, muskrat, collared dove, starling), range expansions, allele-frequency clines and sweeps with spatial data, GBIF time-stamped occurrences
other_kingdoms_hint.fossils: fossil range shifts and Holocene or Pleistocene expansions, PBDB/Neotoma time series of first occurrences along transects, migration-rate estimates

organisms_datasets: test-data/organisms/merged/datasets.json (provenanced dataset records keyed by taxon; reuse by id where it covers your variables)
